tools.name: lookup_guideline
tools.description: Fetch a therapy practice guideline snippet

messages.content: You are a clinical documentation assistant. You do not replace a therapist. Use tools for guidelines and templates only.
Client reports racing thoughts before sleep. Draft a brief CBT-oriented note outline.

I'll pull a short insomnia-related CBT guideline snippet, then a note template.
<tool_call>
{"name": "lookup_guideline", "arguments": {"topic": "cbt_insomnia_racing_thoughts"}}
</tool_call>

<tool_response>
Encourage thought record; schedule worry time earlier; stimulus control for bed.
</tool_response>

Fetching a SOAP-style template next.
<tool_call>
{"name": "session_note_template", "arguments": {"modality": "cbt"}}
</tool_call>

<tool_response>
S: 
O: 
A: 
P: 
</tool_response>

Outline: S — racing thoughts at bedtime; O — client-reported; A — possible cognitive arousal maintaining insomnia; P — introduce thought record and earlier worry window. This is documentation support only, not a diagnosis.

tools.name: crisis_resource_lookup
tools.description: Look up local crisis resources by region

messages.content: You assist clinicians with resources. Escalate clearly if risk language appears. You are not a crisis service.
Supervisee asks what to do if a client mentions passive suicidal ideation without plan. Need resources for CA and a brief safety-planning pointer.

I'll fetch California crisis resources and a safety-planning guideline pointer.
<tool_call>
{"name": "crisis_resource_lookup", "arguments": {"region": "US-CA"}}
</tool_call>

<tool_response>
988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline; local mobile crisis via county behavioral health.
</tool_response>

Pulling a concise safety-planning checklist next.
<tool_call>
{"name": "lookup_guideline", "arguments": {"topic": "safety_planning_passive_si"}}
</tool_call>

<tool_response>
Assess intent/plan/means; collaborative safety plan; document consultation.
</tool_response>

For the supervisee: assess intent, plan, and means; use collaborative safety planning; document consultation. Resources include 988 and county mobile crisis in CA. If imminent risk, follow mandated local emergency procedures.

tools.name: worksheet_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a client worksheet PDF metadata

messages.content: You help therapists assemble psychoeducation materials via tools.
Need a thought-record worksheet and a one-line rationale for introducing it in session 3 of CBT for anxiety.

I'll fetch the thought-record worksheet metadata first.
<tool_call>
{"name": "worksheet_fetch", "arguments": {"name": "cbt_thought_record"}}
</tool_call>

<tool_response>
cbt_thought_record.pdf — 2 columns situation/thought/emotion/alt
</tool_response>

Checking timing guidance for introducing cognitive restructuring tools.
<tool_call>
{"name": "lookup_guideline", "arguments": {"topic": "cbt_anxiety_session3_thought_record"}}
</tool_call>

<tool_response>
After psychoeducation and examples; collaborative first entry in-session.
</tool_response>
Rationale: by session 3, after shared language for thoughts vs feelings, a collaborative in-session thought record builds skill without homework overwhelm. Worksheet: cbt_thought_record.pdf.
